sig: [[["A", "Good evening, everyone, and thank you all for coming to our annual company dinner."], ["A", "Now it's my great pleasure to present this year's Employee of the Year award."], ["A", "This year's winner is Priya Sharma from our customer success team."], ["A", "Priya joined us just three years ago, and she has already made a huge difference."], ["A", "Last spring, she created a new onboarding program for our clients."], ["A", "Thanks to her work, customer complaints dropped by forty percent."], ["A", "She also trained over twenty new team members this year, always with patience and a smile."], ["A", "Her colleagues describe her as the person everyone goes to when there's a problem."], ["A", "As a thank-you, Priya will receive a bonus and an extra five days of paid vacation."], ["A", "She'll also get a reserved parking spot for the next twelve months."], ["A", "Priya, please come up to the stage to accept your award."], ["A", "Everyone, let's give her a big round of applause."]], {"A": "M-US"}]
